input: seeded synthetic BF16 Q/K, unit-scale normal, no model weights
timing_scope: NPUChain input staging, dispatch/wait, output sync, and host BF16 conversion/scaling; excludes input generation/padding, softmax, AV, and complete image generation

phase_semantics.chain_ms: NPUChain input copy, sync, dispatch/wait and output readback; not pure compute.
phase_semantics.host_view_ms: NumPy-to-Torch wrapper and BF16 bit reinterpretation, without numerical conversion.
phase_semantics.host_cast_ms: Host numerical FP32-to-BF16 conversion; exactly zero when output is already BF16.
phase_semantics.host_scale_ms: Remaining BF16 host scale for baseline and QK-only BF16 output.
phase_semantics.rounding: qk_bf16 keeps CPU scaling; direct_bf16 requests accumulator*scale then BF16 store without an explicit pre-scale BF16 cast.

counter_semantics.d2h_visible_bytes: Size of synchronized output BO, not measured physical bus traffic.
counter_semantics.host_cast_ms: Numerical FP32-to-BF16 conversion only; BF16 direct outputs still require a timed zero-copy host view.
counter_semantics.phase_medians: Each phase median is independently selected and need not sum exactly to total median. Chain time includes device conversion, copies, sync, dispatch, wait and readback.
counter_semantics.order: Variants run in the listed fixed order per shape; timings are bounded operator observations, not randomized full-model benchmarks.
